column1: # Barbarian Village's item spawns (Edgeville piece step 5). Items and counts are the OSRS Wiki's Barbarian Village spawn
# list (read 2026-11-01): three beers and two cooked meats on the longhall's tables, a bronze pickaxe in the spinning hut
# and a pot in Peksa's shop. The tiles are the 2004Scape project's map square 48,53 (m48_53.jm2), which the Wiki's rooms
# agree with. Every respawn is the 100 ticks the other files use; the Wiki gives none.
